idea-plugin.name: DiffSense Semantic Compare
idea-plugin.description:
Compare files. Understand what changed.

DiffSense adds a semantic layer on top of the IDE's own diff viewer. Instead of only showing which lines changed, it tells you what changed and whether it matters.

  • JSON, YAML and XML are compared by structure: reordered keys and reformatting are not changes, and every changed value is listed with its path.
  • API responses: compare an expected response with an actual one (raw HTTP, JSON envelope or bare body) and get a pass/fail verdict with every check listed.
  • Impact estimates (informational to critical) with the reason for each one.
  • Ignore rules for paths, order, case and whitespace, in Settings or a project .diffsense.json.
  • Copy or export the summary as Markdown.

Right-click one or two files in the Project view and choose DiffSense | Compare with DiffSense, or use the DiffSense actions in the Tools menu.

Fully local: no network access, no account, no telemetry. Your files never leave your machine.

Java semantic analysis and the test-automation rules from the VS Code extension are planned for a later release.
